hikes.name: Toketee Falls
hikes.blurb: A short walk to a two-tier falls pouring through a frame of dark columnar basalt.

hikes.name: Watson Falls
hikes.blurb: Up to a bridge in front of southern Oregon's tallest falls, 293 feet off a mossy cliff.

hikes.name: Susan Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: An easy walk under maples to a falls in a fern-covered bowl, and Indian mounds above.

hikes.name: Wolf Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: Along Wolf Creek's mossy canyon to a slender, two-part falls.

hikes.name: Umpqua Hot Springs
hikes.blurb: A short climb to hot pools on a travertine ledge above the North Umpqua.

hikes.name: Fall Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: Through a rock crevice and past Jobs Garden to a two-tier falls.

hikes.name: Falls
hikes.blurb: From Fish Lake Trailhead, a 5.9-mile round trip to Falls, with about 1,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Fish Lake
hikes.blurb: From Skimmerhorn Trailhead, a 5.6-mile round trip to Fish Lake, with about 1,550 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Hershberger Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Acker Divide Trailhead, an 11.0-mile round trip to the top of Hershberger Mountain (6,092 ft), with about 2,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Toad Lake
hikes.blurb: From Acker Divide Trailhead, a 6.1-mile round trip to Toad Lake, with about 1,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Falcon Butte
hikes.blurb: From Golden Stairs Trailhead, a 7.9-mile round trip to the top of Falcon Butte (5,429 ft), with about 2,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Cliff Lake
hikes.blurb: From Skimmerhorn Trailhead, a 4.2-mile round trip to Cliff Lake, with about 950 feet of climbing.
